# Support Zekr AI

Thank you for considering supporting the Zekr AI project! Your contributions help us maintain and improve this application.

## Sponsorship Tiers

### 🥉 Bronze - $5/month
- Basic supporter recognition
- Monthly updates on project progress
- Access to sponsor-only discussions

### 🥈 Silver - $19/month
- All Bronze benefits
- Early access to new features
- Direct communication channel
- Mention in project documentation

### 🥇 Gold - $59/month
- All Silver benefits
- Premium support priority
- Feature request consideration
- Recognition on main README
- Monthly Q&A session

### 💎 Platinum - $149/month
- All Gold benefits
- Custom feature implementation
- Dedicated support line
- Executive briefings
- Logo placement on website

## Why Sponsor?

Your sponsorship directly supports:
- ✨ Feature development and improvements
- 🐛 Bug fixes and maintenance
- 📚 Documentation and tutorials
- 🌍 Localization and language support
- 🚀 Infrastructure and hosting costs
- 👥 Community management and support
